slides.body:
Emerging Visual Realities (EVRealities) EVRealities is a marketplace for selling, purchasing, and licensing virtual reality content. We’re a community of professional VR photographers, reporters, artists, and humanitarians submitting immersive content of daily current events. Through our wire distribution and WebVR gallery clients can quickly discover and preview compelling immersive content for documentation and reporting.

www.evrealities.com
